title: Tic-Tac-Chain
tagline: Unleash the Power of Cross-Chain Tic Tac Toe: Where Blockchain Meets Classic Fun!
description:
Our Cross-Chain Tic Tac Toe Blockchain Game is a cutting-edge gaming platform that combines the timeless allure of Tic Tac Toe with the revolutionary capabilities of blockchain technology. At its core, our project leverages the innovative Wormhole cross-chain protocol, allowing players to seamlessly engage with the game across various blockchain networks. This means that players can effortlessly transfer in-game assets and game progress, irrespective of the blockchain they initially started on. Wormhole acts as a secure bridge that ensures the interconnectedness of gameplay, fostering a truly borderless gaming experience.

To guarantee the integrity of game statistics and turn management, we employ the power of Tableland, a decentralized SQL solution. By storing crucial data, including game statistics, win-loss records, move history, and more, on the blockchain, we ensure transparency and fairness throughout the gaming process. With every move recorded on the blockchain, players can trust in the accuracy of their gaming history.

Our frontend is powered by NextJS, offering a responsive and intuitive interface that enables players to easily engage with the game on a variety of devices and platforms. Additionally, we've integrated with Avalanche Fuji and Polygon Mumbai blockchains to record game transactions efficiently. These high-performance blockchains provide fast and cost-effective transaction processing, ensuring a seamless and hassle-free gaming experience. Join us on this transformative journey where we redefine the landscape of gaming, creating a space where blockchain technology enriches classic entertainment, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of gaming.
how_its_made: This project is like a super-connected Tic Tac Toe game that runs on different blockchains. It works smoothly because we use a special tool called @wormholecrypto that helps different chains send messages to each other. When you play, all your game details, like who won or lost and whose turn it is, get saved in a super-safe digital storage system called @tableland. We use @nextjs to make the game look nice and easy to use. And when you play, all the game records are kept on two scalable blockchains Avalanche Fuji @avax and Polygon Mumbai 0xPolygonLabs.
